gloss: beautiful appearance; fine view; aesthetic appeal

definitions.gloss: beautiful appearance; fine view; scenic beauty; aesthetic appeal
definitions.explanation: The beautiful visual appearance of a place, building, or area, especially as something to be preserved or maintained.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}の{美観|びかん}を{守|まも}る。
examples.english: To preserve the beauty of the town.

examples.japanese: {違法|いほう}な{看板|かんばん}は{美観|びかん}を{損|そこ}なう。
examples.english: Illegal signs damage the aesthetic appearance.

examples.japanese: {倉敷|くらしき}の{美観|びかん}{地区|ちく}は{白壁|しらかべ}の{蔵|くら}が{並|なら}ぶ{美|うつく}しい{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: The Kurashiki aesthetic district is a beautiful area lined with white-walled storehouses.

notes:
Composed of {美|び} (beauty) + {観|かん} (view, appearance). Often used in the context of urban planning, preservation, and regulations about maintaining the visual quality of an area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美観|びかん}を{守|まも}る — to protect the beautiful appearance
- {美観|びかん}を{損|そこ}なう — to damage the aesthetic appearance
- {美観|びかん}{地区|ちく} — aesthetic/scenic district (a legally designated area)
- {都市|とし}{美観|びかん} — urban aesthetics
- {美観|びかん}を{保|たも}つ — to maintain the beauty

CULTURAL NOTE:
{美観|びかん}{地区|ちく} (aesthetic districts) are designated areas in Japanese cities where building appearance and signage are regulated to preserve traditional or scenic beauty. The most famous is the {倉敷|くらしき}{美観|びかん}{地区|ちく} in Okayama Prefecture.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {景観|けいかん} — landscape, scenery (broader; includes natural and urban views)
- {外観|がいかん} — outward appearance (of a building or object)
- {風景|ふうけい} — scenery, landscape (natural or general)
